# Conflict Rule 1 ## Avoid random deathmatch (RDM).
[italic][color=yellow]Faction Conflict:[/color][/italic] - TSF and PDV are in a [color=cyan][bold]cold war[/bold][/color]. Check your PDA: [color=cyan][bold]WAR LEVEL: COLD[/bold][/color] means there is a ceasefire, [color=red][bold]WAR LEVEL: HOT[/bold][/color] means [textlink="war has been declared" link="WFRuleConflictFiveDeclaringWar"].
- While [color=cyan][bold]COLD[/bold][/color], being in the other faction is [color=red][bold]not[/bold][/color] a reason to attack. You need an RP reason and escalation like in any other conflict. -- You don't need escalation if they shoot first, or board or hack your ship. -- Or if they stay within [color=yellow][bold]512 meters[/bold][/color] of your base for [color=yellow][bold]30 seconds[/bold][/color] after being warned. -- Or if you catch them spying or sabotaging on your ship or base (that person only).
- Event POIs (vaults, weapons caches, wrecks and other bluespace events), PDV drop pods and Monolithic Fragments are [color=red][bold]conflict zones[/bold][/color], even while COLD. TSF and PDV can fight each other within [color=yellow][bold]512 meters[/bold][/color] of one without escalation. -- The fight stays there. Do not hunt them down once they leave.
- [bold]An incident is not a war.[/bold] Force stays with the people and ships involved and ends when one side breaks off.
- [bold]NPCs are fair game.[/bold] Attacking NPC ships, crews or turrets is never a rulebreak. -- Attacking the other faction's NPCs while COLD counts as shooting first, so their players can come after you. -- Base turrets ignore the ceasefire and shoot the other faction on sight.
- While [color=red][bold]HOT[/bold][/color], faction conflict is allowed at all times.
- Any conflict is allowed with a [color=red][bold]proper, reasonable RP reason[/bold][/color]. A stolen magazine may be a reason for a fistfight, but not a meatgrinder. -- Using metaknowledge (external knowledge) of companies and antagonists (ADS/Chimera/Asakim Etc.,) found in the [color=cornflowerblue]Discord or Guidebook[/color] [color=green][bold]is allowed[/bold][/color]. For example, the [color=red]RedSail Corsairs[/color] may be [color=red][bold]Killed On Sight[/bold][/color] (per line 5) as they are known pirates. Although the [color=yellow]Viper Group[/color] requires escalation, as they do contracting, not pirate work.
- Combat escalation should be stated in local, shortband, or broadband chat/radio channels and must be [color=green]clearly declared[/color] to those involved. (ex. "It's over Jackson, die fucker!!" in local chat, or shortband)
- Escalation to combat immediately is allowed in select circumstances such as cases of [color=red]confirmed pirates[/color], [color=yellow]chimera/ADC[/color], etc. -- Vessel crew is allowed to [color=red][bold]KOS[/bold][/color] anyone who hacks or breaks their locked doors under "Castle doctrine." -- Vessels entering a range of [color=yellow][bold]512 meters[/bold][/color] within an active combat zone [bold]do not[/bold] require escalation, and [color=red][bold]you can immediately fire upon them[/bold][/color], no matter the IFF.
